name: Send: full flow 13 · Preview, Send button
title: Send

catalogue.note: Mara 2.0 (Android) Send, the user’s redesign, the whole flow with the add-contact branch: 360×800 at real size, nothing scaled, every number is the file’s (Plugin API). Built to be wired into a prototype: all 15 screens of the flow carry one and the same stylesheet, a class is a component and the same component is the same markup on every screen; an element’s style attribute holds only where this instance sits (and a text’s width). data-part marks what a user taps or types into and the layers a prototype shows, hides or moves; data-state marks the drawn state (enabled, disabled, insufficient, active, inactive, selected) and the stylesheet keys the state’s fill, colour and opacity on it. No JavaScript. Auto-layout frames are flex with Figma’s direction, gap, padding and alignment; hug-sized frames size themselves (every box lands within 0.25px of Figma’s). No frame chrome: the frame’s 0 4 24 shadow is left off (it has no corner radius and no stroke). Preview: recipient, the two-column summary, Send. Every avatar in the file is a photo with an opaque “CG” monogram circle on top of it, the same box: the photo never shows and is not built; the monogram (gradient ring, gradient letters) is code. Type is live Satoshi 400/500/700 and Roboto 400 (the keyboard digits) from the files on this Mac, embedded whole. Satoshi here has no ₦ (U+20A6): each naira sign is Figma’s own outline of the glyph at that weight (Regular, Medium, Bold), inline, 0.572em wide. Status bar, bottom bar, icons and the keyboard’s four function keys are Figma’s SVG export of each node, unchanged. Figma rounds every text baseline to the nearest pixel and Chrome floors it; where the two differ the line carries a 1px offset worked out from the font’s own metrics. What is left in the diff is glyph and curve antialiasing; flat fills match, except two that Figma’s export draws one level darker than the file’s value (#FDECE4 comes out #FCECE4, #B71723 at 56% on white comes out #D67D84 for #D77D84). The Figma export is the frame with its shadow (408×848), cut to the frame.
